title: Apply a human-resolved planning merge to execution-free imported tasks (narrow cross-host pilot)
outcome: Apply a human-resolved planning merge to execution-free imported tasks (narrow cross-host pilot)
acceptance: An explicit preview/apply mode applies a selected, human-resolved task-tree candidate to an existing imported planning graph, changing only title, outcome and plain acceptance strings of Open or Proposed items, through existing canonical Revised events in one transaction; ImportOrigin and RestoredRecord rows, ids and creation attribution stay byte-identical, and ordinary import behaviour does not broaden

Admission is positive and conservative: every project item is a validated task-sync restore with no work run, root execution, claim, handoff offer, completion seal, run evidence, obligation or restored evidence, and local history is only run-free project Revised events; any other item, field, lifecycle, edge, note, activity, binding or profile difference, or a moved local basis, refuses the whole batch with zero writes and a structured visible reason

Repeat apply of the same candidate returns already-current with no new events; a lost reply is recovered by re-applying the same candidate; no new durable kind, table, column, index, receipt shape or projection derivation is added (a required format change stops the slice and switches to the agreed fallback)

Focused fail-first regressions cover repeated merges into the same populated store, every refusal class above, mid-batch rollback, stale basis, re-export equality and verify_all health; then the full gate and the review pair pass on the frozen input
disposal_reason: GREG STOP (via Advisor #1649, 2026-10-17 23:31Z): "STOP w-499d and every special apply human-resolved planning merge command/slice. Do not code, gate, review, claim, or estimate that mechanism." The pilot is ordinary explicit git fetch, a designated Merger agent's guided Git merge, and the existing import. Zero code effects (per 9860 via Advisor #1651): only a claim, a clean detached worktree and a note read; claim and root released and worktree removed without force.
